title: Photoelectric apparatus
back: Light on emitter C in an evacuated tube; collector A at variable potential; microammeter reads the photocurrent.

title: Photocurrent against collector potential
back: Brighter light: higher saturation, same V₀. Higher frequency: larger V₀, same saturation.

title: Stopping potential against frequency
back: Straight line of slope h/e (same for all metals); intercept on the ν-axis = threshold frequency.

title: Einstein’s photoelectric equation
back: Explains threshold frequency, frequency dependence and instant emission.

title: Work function and threshold
back: Below ν₀ no electrons come out, however intense the light.

title: Photon energy and momentum
back: Intensity counts photons; frequency fixes each photon’s energy.

title: de Broglie wavelength
back: Same V: λ_e > λ_p > λ_α. Same p: equal λ.

title: Intensity or frequency?
back: "Intensity = itne electrons; Frequency = force": intensity changes the photocurrent, frequency changes K_max and V₀.
